full_frame_render: Renders image and video assets full frame with cover fit, no unexpected cropping by default
eased_motion_apply: Applies smooth directional pan motion matched to configured direction vector for static assets to add dynamic movement
ripple_effect_apply: Renders subtle ripple displacement effect using native SVG filters with no external dependencies
effect_prop_safety: All numeric props from props.effects.props are validated with typeof checks before usage, no unsafe untyped access
interpolate_rules: All Remotion interpolate calls use valid string 'clamp' values for extrapolateLeft and extrapolateRight
no_banned_apis: No fetch, WebSocket, storage, eval, dynamic imports or other restricted browser APIs used in component code
import_validation: Imports only from 'remotion' and uses type-only import for GeneratedComponentRenderProps from component-registry
segment_compatibility: Works as intended across all 3 target segment_ids without layout or performance breaks
single_composite_behavior: Only implements composite effect layer responsibility, no unrelated text, audio or mask logic included
